articles.title: What a bill shows
articles.body: A bill shows the period, the charges, and the balance on the pinned snapshot. The figure is not a decision and it is not a new price arrangement.

articles.title: How to give a meter reading
phrases: how do I give a meter reading
how do I read my meter
how do I submit a reading
articles.body: You can give a meter reading by telling us the digits on the meter. This assistant can propose that a person submits the reading. It does not submit the reading itself.

articles.title: What a direct debit is
articles.body: A direct debit is a regular payment the customer agrees with the supplier. This assistant cannot set one up or change the amount.

articles.title: What a payment plan request is
articles.body: A customer can ask for a payment plan to be considered. This assistant can propose that request. A person decides whether a plan is offered. A plan is not agreed here.

articles.title: What the Priority Services Register is
phrases: what is the priority services register
articles.body: The Priority Services Register is a list an energy supplier keeps for customers who may need extra help. This assistant can propose a referral. A person decides whether to add anyone. Nobody is added here.

articles.title: Extra help with water
phrases: what extra help can I get with water
articles.body: If a customer needs extra help with water or wastewater, a person at the company looks at what they need. This assistant does not decide that help. No water licence condition number is stated here.

articles.title: What a tariff is
articles.body: A tariff is the price arrangement for supply. This assistant cannot change a tariff and cannot tell a customer which tariff to pick.

articles.title: How to reach a person
articles.body: A customer can ask for a human advisor at any time. The synthetic contact for these invented suppliers is 01632 960000. That number is not a live line.

articles.body: This leaflet is past the starter stale window. It is not quoted as current.
